tl;dr: If you want to be able to toggle features of my mod marked with an asterisk without returning to main menu, activate this. Long version: I have optimized my mod for event performance so many events are not bound when the feature is supposed to be disabled. You trade a tiny bit of performance for convenience.
Bag soil type you are standing on
Do you want to permanently disable bikinitools?
This module is disabled for multiplayer clients
Removes all vehicles in the player's current cell
Drop all items in containers onto the floor below them so you can dismantle them easier. This will leave moveables like radios, furniture and some other weird items in the containers and skip them
The corpse stacker automates picking up corpses around you and puts them in the location you stood when you issued the order
Chop all the trees in an area around you. It will even equip a new axe when one breaks, so it's perfect for stone axes. Just try not to die of exertion
Not recommended. This adds 4 ridiculous automation radius sizes to choose from
Remove grass and / or shrubbery in an area. You can choose either one or both and enjoy the time saved
Create car key from context menu
Adds an option in the context menu to create a new key for it in your inventory. If the car is hotwired, the option will not be shown
The Gravel Buddy helps you automate picking up dirt / sand / gravel. Stand on the soil you want, start it and let it do the work for you

When activated the player will try to dismantle everything in an area or the room you're in. This works by the same rules as normal disassembly. Have your tools with you and they will be equipped automatically. Be careful when speeding up and changing floors when the game is lagging because the game tends to crash
Need an icon? Why not Zoidberg?
Chop all the trees in an area around you. It will even equip a new axe when one breaks, so it's perfect for stone axes. Just try not to die of exertion
Enables an option in the context menu of locked vehicles to *find* an open door
This takes into account the actually installed parts and repairs them, unlike other mods that fill up all slots in tuning and modular vehicles
Enables an option in the context menu for switching the vehicle skin, if the vehicle supports it
Creates a context menu option for unlocking locked trunks on vehicles and containers. The option is only present if the trunk is locked. This can fail if the lock is broken
Put away / re-equip items when entering / leaving vehicles
The character will put away primary / secondary equipped items and get them out automatically when leaving the vehicle again
Enables you to remove a single vehicle via the context menu
This creates a new context menu entry for spawning vehicles. They are sorted by condition and letters, so you don't have to scroll multiple pages long
With 41.69 the devs introduced a native way to transmit the changed skin. If this does not work for you, try this option.

This will permanently disable bikinitools for you. This option is for servers where the admins decided to add it and some of the clients do not want it. Enabling it again requires you to either modify or delete the file %1

Normally automations have a faster interval for processing tasks. With this mode enabled the interval is reduced to once per ingame minute. This will look a bit more sluggish with the player standing around a fraction of a second but have much less of a performance impact on the game
This option is currently not available because of a mod conflict
Try to pick up nails after scrapping

When using the context menu it can get a bit laggy, because depending on enabled automations there are calculations for viability taking place, meaning checks if area size x can be processed or not. With this option disabled those checks are skipped to gain better performance
Try to put unequipped items into a bag
If there's a bag available with enough capacity, the unequipped item will be stored there. If no bag is available, the items will be put in player inventory
Please quit to main menu for all changes to take effect
The player does not say anything anymore to increase immersion
When this is active the spawned cars will be in perfect condition
When this is active you will find a key to the spawned car in your inventory
Try to empty containers before scrapping them. Restrictions apply: see container unloader option
When *Open Sesame!* is not your thing, you can enable this so it's more serious
Try to use skin names instead of indices
Do you want to remove this vehicle?
Do you want to remove all vehicles in this cell?
Create a key for this vehicle
I can see an open door. Lucky me!
